description: This file defines the GetParentGroups class, which retrieves all parent group IDs of a specified group within the vtiger CRM system. It includes a method getAllParentGroups that performs recursive database queries to build a list of parent groups.

classes.name: GetParentGroups
classes.description: A class responsible for retrieving all parent group IDs of a given group in the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: getAllParentGroups
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all parent group IDs for the specified group ID and stores them in the class's parent_groups array.
